summary: Completed public API and responsive UI regression testing for Cozy Loop Crochet. Core routes, contact persistence, article routes, filters, cookie persistence, mobile menu, legal pages, and custom 404 passed.
action_items: Add all 10 /article/{slug} URLs to sitemap.xml for complete SEO coverage.
Consider implementing newsletter submit behavior or explicitly labeling it as a non-functional signup area if newsletter capture is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: sitemap.xml currently lists only six non-article routes despite ten reachable article routes; this weakens discoverability.
Newsletter controls are present but have no submit handler, validation, or persistence; this was not required as an API flow but is a potentially misleading interactive control.
seed_data_creation: One TEST-prefixed contact message was created through the public API for persistence verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://craft-nexus-14.preview.emergentagent.com. Initial browser assertion had a timing race; rerun with a short wait passed. Cookie localStorage from browser context may need clearing for first-visit banner tests.
rca of the issue: No runtime API or UI failure reproduced. Sitemap omission is static content: frontend/public/sitemap.xml contains home, blog, about, contact, privacy, and terms only; article slugs are generated in content.js but never listed in sitemap.xml.
